TOP: the band between the B3 and B1 lines is clearly denser (foreshortened, steep) than the arm and the web beyond B1, matching the CAD shading; flat, the strip and web would show one uniform density. TOP: the neck outline, including the notch where the arm meets the strip, matches the CAD, and the strip just past B3 shows the dense (steep) point band.
